faqs.question: How do you do social media marketing for real estate?
faqs.answer: Pick two or three platforms your buyers use, set up a clear profile with your RERA details and one action, post content that answers buyer questions on a steady weekly calendar, reply to comments and DMs quickly, move conversations to WhatsApp, and put paid budget behind the posts that bring enquiries.

faqs.question: Which social media platform is best for real estate in India?
faqs.answer: For most builders, brokers and channel partners, Instagram and Facebook cover first contact, YouTube suits buyers researching in depth and NRI buyers, LinkedIn suits commercial property, and WhatsApp is where the follow-up happens.

faqs.question: What is the 5-3-1 rule in social media?
faqs.answer: It is an informal rule of thumb with several versions. For real estate, a useful version is: out of every nine posts, five give value, three build connection and one sells. It keeps an account from only posting ads.

faqs.question: What should a real estate Facebook page or Instagram profile include?
faqs.answer: A searchable name, a clean logo or face, a one-line bio saying what you sell and where, the RERA registration number and authority website, one clear action such as a WhatsApp button, and pinned posts or highlights covering location, floor plans, progress and FAQs.

faqs.question: What are good real estate post ideas?
faqs.answer: Sample flat walkthroughs, monthly construction updates, real drive times to the metro and schools, explainers on carpet area and cost sheets, meet-the-team posts, possession day photos shared with permission, and site visit weekend announcements.

faqs.question: Do social media posts need a RERA number?
faqs.answer: Yes, if they promote a project. Section 11(2) of the RERA Act requires advertisements to carry the registration number and the state authority’s website. Put the number on the creative itself, because images get forwarded without captions. This is not legal advice.

faqs.question: Can organic social media alone generate real estate leads?
faqs.answer: Rarely at a steady rate. Organic posts build proof, keep you remembered and create warm audiences, but reach is limited. Most teams use organic content as the base and paid ads to scale the posts that already work.

faqs.question: How should you reply to real estate enquiries on social media?
faqs.answer: Quickly, from one inbox in Meta Business Suite. Answer briefly in public, move the conversation to WhatsApp with the price sheet and floor plans, ask two qualifying questions, offer a specific visit slot, and log which post the lead came from.
